products.product_description: Raw Frozen Tuna Chunks Product of Indonesia. The bulk frozen tuna products can be identified from the Purchase Order Number (PO#) printed on each product carton box end panel.
products.reason_for_recall: Osamu Corporation is recalling frozen chunk, ground, sliced saku, saku, and loin tuna due to potential Salmonella contamination.
